question: What has a mouth but never eats, a bed but never sleeps?
What follows you all day and vanishes at night, though it never leaves?
What grows when it eats and dies when it drinks?
What devours all things: birds, beasts, trees and flowers, gnaws iron and grinds stone?
What breaks as soon as you name it?
A box without hinges, key or lid, yet golden treasure inside is hid.
I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. What am I?
The more you take, the more you leave behind.
Cities without houses, forests without trees, rivers without water.
Tall when young, short when old, I weep while I work.
